name: Reef Larder
senses: darkvision 120 ft., blindsight 60 ft.; Passive Perception 16

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The larder makes three attacks, using Bite or Maw Grab in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Keel Roll.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Acid damage.

Actions.name: Bone Chum (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 67 (15d8) Acid damage. *Success:* Half damage.

Actions.name: Keel Roll
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17, one Huge or smaller creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target is pulled up to 30 feet straight toward the larder by the keel it has pinned and has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18). While Grappled this way, the target has the Restrained condition.

Actions.name: Maw Grab
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18).
Actions.flavor: The larder's maw closes over a struggling creature and drags it into the hold of its gut.

Actions.name: Grounding Surge
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 17, one creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target is pulled up to 30 feet straight toward the larder, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn.

Traits.name: Adhesive
Traits.text: The larder adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the larder is also Grappled by it (escape DC 18). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.

lore: An old drake grown too heavy for open water, it holds a stretch of reef as its larder and sinks any hull anchored over its territory, leaving the sea picked clean as a warning to the next captain.
